questions.scenario: It is September 5th (Teachers' Day) and your class is throwing a surprise party for your class teacher. What is your main job?

options.A: I am organizing the 'Students vs Teachers' cricket or tug-of-war match on the school ground.
options.B: I am preparing an extremely well-researched, deep speech or quiz about the history of Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.
options.C: I am bringing the colorful chalks, drawing an elaborate 'Happy Teachers' Day' on the blackboard, and making a handmade card.
options.D: I am collecting the 50-rupee 'chanda' (contribution) from everyone, buying the cake, and making sure the party starts exactly on time.

questions.scenario: Your Math teacher is absent and you get a 'Proxy' (substitution) period! What is your immediate reaction?

options.A: I beg the substitution teacher to let the boys and girls go down to the sports ground for a quick game of basketball or football.
options.B: I sit quietly and try to finally solve that one impossible trigonometry question from the RD Sharma reference book.
options.C: I turn to the last page of my rough notebook and start playing 'Name-Place-Animal-Thing' or drawing caricatures with my benchmate.
options.D: I go to the blackboard, write 'SILENCE' in capital letters, and warn the class that the strict coordinator is patrolling the corridor.

questions.scenario: It is exactly 1 day before the final Board Exam. Your best friend calls you, panicking because they don't understand a topic. How do you help?

options.A: I give them an energetic pep talk, tell them to stop crying, drink water, and focus purely on getting passing marks. 'Tu kar lega bhai!'
options.B: I break down the complex physics derivation step-by-step using pure logic, explaining the core concept until they fully grasp it.
options.C: I make up a funny Hindi song or a silly mnemonic (like VIBGYOR) to help them magically memorize the long list of points.
options.D: I create a strict 12-hour timetable for them: 'Study Chapter 1 for 45 mins, sleep at midnight, wake up at 5 AM for revision.'

questions.scenario: The Annual School Function is coming up. How are you contributing to the massive event?

options.A: I am in the march-past squad, practicing my drill daily in the hot sun and loving every second of it.
options.B: I am helping the science department build a complex, working model of a hydraulic bridge for the academic exhibition.
options.C: I am heavily involved in choreographing the group dance, designing the costumes, and painting the stage backdrops.
options.D: I am the backstage manager, holding the master schedule, and making sure the VIP chief guest gets their tea on time.

questions.scenario: A 6th-standard junior comes to you crying because they got severely scolded by a strict teacher. How do you handle it?

options.A: I take them to the school canteen, buy them a samosa, give them a high-five, and tell them to 'shake it off and be tough.'
options.B: I calmly explain to them logically why they lost marks in their test and how they can study better for the next one.
options.C: I distract them by telling an animated, dramatic, and funny story about a time I got scolded, just to see them smile.
options.D: I calm them down, figure out exactly what happened, and then go speak to their class monitor to resolve the situation diplomatically.

questions.scenario: Your group is assigned a major Holiday Homework project. What part do you naturally take over?

options.A: I do the physical running around—going to the local stationery shop to buy chart paper, thermocol, and glue.
options.B: I do the hardcore research on Wikipedia, fact-check everything, and write the actual content for the project file.
options.C: I take charge of the presentation, making sure the headings are written in beautiful cursive with three different colored glitter pens.
options.D: I act as the group leader, assigning specific tasks to each member and setting hard deadlines so we don't scramble on the last day.

questions.scenario: It is the start of the 2-month Summer Vacation! What is your primary goal?

options.A: Waking up at 6 AM every day to attend a rigorous cricket, badminton, or swimming coaching camp.
options.B: Finally having the free time to read encyclopedias, learn a coding language, or prepare for the Science Olympiad.
options.C: Joining a hobby class for pottery, learning the guitar, or making a creative scrapbook of all my memories.
options.D: Planning the entire family's summer trip itinerary, from booking the train tickets to managing the daily travel schedule.

questions.scenario: Someone in your class tries to sneak a smartphone into school and gets caught by the discipline committee. What's your reaction?

options.A: I'm just annoyed because I wanted to use it to quickly check the live cricket score during the recess.
options.B: I mentally calculate the statistical probability of them getting caught based on the PT Sir's daily patrol route.
options.C: I wish they had asked me first—I know a highly creative way to hide it inside a hollowed-out geometry box.
options.D: I told them beforehand it was a terrible idea, because confiscation means parents are called and it creates unnecessary drama.

questions.scenario: You have a free Sunday evening at home. How do you spend it?

options.A: Playing gully cricket or badminton in the colony park until the sun goes down completely.
options.B: Watching a mind-bending documentary on YouTube or reading a deep sci-fi/mystery novel.
options.C: Watching a Bollywood movie, trying out a DIY craft from Instagram, or painting.
options.D: Organizing my study table, sorting out my school bag for Monday, and planning my entire week in a diary.

questions.scenario: When you think about your dream workplace as an adult, what is the ultimate motivation for you?

options.A: Being physically fit, highly active, and wearing comfortable track pants and sneakers to work every day.
options.B: Being highly respected as an absolute genius who knows everything about a specific, complex subject.
options.C: Being loved by everyone for making everyday life colorful, fun, expressive, and emotionally warm.
options.D: Being the ultimate boss who makes the rules, commands respect, and runs the entire organization smoothly.

Sports_Coach.title: Sports Coach / PE Teacher
Sports_Coach.primary_match_text: The Energy Powerhouse! You love being on the move, leading teams, and keeping everyone fit and active.
Sports_Coach.day_in_the_life: Blowing the whistle on the ground, conducting morning assemblies, coaching the school teams for inter-school tournaments, and teaching the importance of discipline and stamina.
Sports_Coach.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream, preferably with Physical Education) -> B.A/B.Sc/B.Com -> Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) -> Master of Physical Education (M.P.Ed) or NIS Diploma.

Subject_Expert_Professor.title: Subject Matter Expert / Professor
Subject_Expert_Professor.primary_match_text: The Knowledge Ninja! You are analytical, logical, and love diving deep into the 'why' and 'how' of things.
Subject_Expert_Professor.day_in_the_life: Delivering engaging lectures to senior students, solving complex doubts on the blackboard, conducting lab experiments, and writing detailed research papers.
Subject_Expert_Professor.alternative_match_text: Research Scientist, Curriculum Developer, Ed-Tech Educator
Subject_Expert_Professor.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Stream matching your interest: Science/Commerce/Humanities) -> Bachelor's Degree (B.Sc/B.A/B.Com) -> Master's Degree (M.Sc/M.A/M.Com) -> Clear UGC NET -> Pursue Ph.D. for College level, or B.Ed for School level.

Creative_Arts_Teacher.title: Primary School / Arts Teacher
Creative_Arts_Teacher.primary_match_text: The Creative Storyteller! You bring color and imagination to everything you do, making learning incredibly fun.
Creative_Arts_Teacher.day_in_the_life: Singing rhymes with kids, teaching painting techniques, managing craft supplies, and creating a warm, colorful classroom environment where students feel safe and expressive.
Creative_Arts_Teacher.alternative_match_text: Child Psychologist, Special Educator, Art Director
Creative_Arts_Teacher.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream, Arts preferred) -> Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed) / Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed) OR Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA) -> B.Ed -> CTET/STET Certification.

Principal_Coordinator.title: Principal / Academic Coordinator
Principal_Coordinator.primary_match_text: The Master Manager! You are a natural leader who loves setting rules, organizing events, and keeping things running smoothly.
Principal_Coordinator.day_in_the_life: Designing the school timetable, holding meetings with teachers and anxious parents, making big decisions for the school's future, and walking the corridors to ensure total discipline.
Principal_Coordinator.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream) -> Bachelor's Degree -> B.Ed -> Master's Degree (M.Ed) -> Years of teaching experience -> Clearing state/central level principal recruitments (like KVS/NVS) or earning internal promotions.
